description: This file is a shell script used for testing various internationalization (i18n) encodings and commit message encodings in a Git project. It contains test setup, execution, and validation procedures for encoding compliance, including handling of various character encodings such as UTF-8, UTF-16, ISO8859-1, eucJP, and ISO-2022-JP.

methods.name: compare_with
methods.description: Compares the output of 'git show' with a provided reference file, handling character set conversions if necessary.

methods.name: test_commit_autosquash_flags
methods.description: Tests git commit with specific flags ('fixup', 'squash') in different encodings and verifies correct behavior.

methods.name: test_commit_autosquash_multi_encoding
methods.description: Tests rebasing and autosquash functionality across different character encodings.
